summary: Cycle 3 confirms Until/Since sorries require plan revision. Compositionality false on Prior structures. ih_exist constant-parent limitation prevents formula enrichment. Three alternative approaches identified; Option A (strengthen ExistPart) recommended.
blockers: Until backward (KampBypass.lean:356): Formula.untl compat_disj Formula.top is provably too weak. ih_exist only handles constant parent env (fun _ => t), but Until zone 3-var conditions require [y, x, t] with x != t. Compositionality (1-var NFs + ordering determine 2-var NF) is false on Prior structures -- counterexample: M=(Z,<), env1=(0,2), env2=(0,1), k=1. Z with no predicates IS Prior (UZ/SZ trivially satisfied).
Since backward (KampBypass.lean:368): Symmetric to Until blocker.

continuation_context.recommended_approach: Option A: Strengthen ExistPart to condition on parent NF at arity r rather than parent_atoms at arity 1. This allows ih_exist to express quantifier conditions for non-constant parent envs. The formula for Until zone becomes: Until (compat_disj AND quant_conj_using_strengthened_ih_exist) top.
alternative_approaches: Option B: Generalize VecEA2 bracket construction from k=0 to k>0, replacing nf_depth0_char_formula with ih_char (~1000+ lines per direction)
Option C: Revive Rabinovich negation closure (Lemma 5.1) from boneyard (~500 lines)
key_findings: Compositionality is false on Prior structures (Z with no predicates IS Prior)
ih_exist at x gives env [y,x,x], ih_exist at t gives env [y,t,t] -- neither matches [y,x,t]
nf_extend_fwd loses one depth level (K+1 -> K), insufficient for target depth
Eq zone works ONLY because x=t makes parent env constant [t,t]
ExistPart conditioned on parent NF (not just parent_atoms) would enable non-constant parent encoding
